ValidationRule.description: Gateway is the single source of truth and every query filters on it; the record type only drives the page and the action bar. This stops the two drifting apart. Silent on a record carrying neither type, so no one is blocked by record type access.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The record type does not match the Gateway. A UAEDDS mandate needs the UAEDDS record type and a FAB mandate needs FAB Legacy, because the record type is what decides which screen and which actions this record gets.
